purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom Conflux law profiles that require explicit elemental family mapping. This records authored elemental-family identity only; it does not prove dynamic family selection, spell/object family correlation, battle stack identity, day-phase choice, reveal target selection, cooldown mutation, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: live battle stack or party unit SID proof
spell school or spell SID to elemental family correlation proof
object SID or category to elemental family correlation proof
day phase to elemental family correlation proof
law owner to selected family correlation proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: Conflux faction membership counted as elemental family mapping
any elemental unit counted without family identity
Pixie counted as elemental family mapping
Firebird counted as elemental family mapping
day phase counted without explicit family correlation
conflux.day-phase-elemental-calendar.notes: Conflux day-phase elemental calendar requires explicit authored elemental family mapping and separate day/battle timing proof; Conflux membership or day phase alone is not enough.
